description: This file handles media sending functionalities for the BlueBubbles plugin, including media size validation, local file resolution, remote media fetching, and message attachment handling.

methods.name: assertMediaWithinLimit
methods.description: Checks if media size exceeds the maximum allowed size in bytes.

methods.name: resolveLocalMediaPath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a local path string.

methods.name: expandHomePath
methods.description: Expands '~' or '~/...' to the user's home directory.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredPath
methods.description: Resolves a media local root path, handling file URLs and expanding home directories.

methods.name: isPathInsideRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a specified root directory.

methods.name: resolveMediaLocalRoots
methods.description: Retrieves media local root directories from account configuration.

methods.name: assertLocalMediaPathAllowed
methods.description: Validates and reads local media files within allowed roots.

methods.name: resolveFilenameFromSource
methods.description: Extracts filename from media source URL or path.

methods.name: sendBlueBubblesMedia
methods.description: Main function to send media via BlueBubbles, handling local/remote media, size limits, and message attachment.
